boxwork.summary: NASA's own description of the boxwork result is qualitative. These are the only chemistry statements taken from it; the layer does not add its own interpretation.

quotes.text: The bedrock between the boxwork ridges has a different composition than other layers of Mount Sharp.
quotes.source: NASA, "NASA's Curiosity Mars Rover Starts Unpacking Boxwork Formations", 23 June 2025

quotes.text: The bedrock below these ridges likely formed when groundwater trickling through the rock left behind minerals.

boxwork.not_found: No peer-reviewed paper with boxwork ridge-vs-hollow oxide numbers was found in this session, so none is cited.
